IIT Madras and CAMS Partner for Fintech Innovation

Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT-M) and Computer Age Management Services (CAMS) have expanded their collaboration in the fintech sector. This partnership aims to create an accessible digital finance ecosystem, with a specific focus on developing solutions for individuals with disabilities. The initiative involves an innovation lab to drive this development.
